local_upload_compatibility_20261020.request: During Marketplace integration, keep the original local upload installation workflow; the user will test local uploads only.
baseline_findings: The earlier integration had turned off force by default and disabled its switch before preview.
The earlier common transaction rejected reinstallation of old provider-less local packages and required extra revision/provider confirmation.
corrections: Local upload mode restores the original force=true default and enabled overwrite switch; selecting files preserves the selection.
Ordinary uploads send the original multipart fields: files/file_paths_json or file, enable, force, metadata; no new identity/revision fields are required.
Only the server recognizes multipart local uploads as the compatibility entry. JSON payloads cannot enable it; URL and Marketplace entries keep their existing checks.

Provider-less old local or unknown-origin installs can be reinstalled. Known provider metadata is preserved when old packages omit it; unknown identity remains unknown; explicit known publisher conflicts remain rejected.
Permissions sync and force=false same-version behavior remain compatible, while the single installed version and transaction recovery are retained.
Local uploads retain the supplied install metadata and the original runtime/tenant enable pipeline.
